subject: How to customise the text on the legend box

messages.author: f77d46b4bbd7a974
messages.subject: How to customise the text on the legend box
parts:
Here's my code

a <- c(10000,12000,34000,35000,25000,50000,80000,7000)
b <- c(.1,.25,.5,.75,.9)
d <- quantile(a,b)
p <- c(10,25,50,75,90)
dframe <- data.frame(percentages=p,salaries=d)
library("ggplot2")

dframe$salarytext <- paste("$", as.character(dframe$salaries), sep="")

ggp <- ggplot(data=dframe, aes(p, d, label=dframe$salarytext,
data=dframe$salaries, col=paste(100 - dframe$percentages,"% of
salaries surveyed has more than ",dframe$salarytext,sep=""))) +
opts(legend.position="bottom")
ggp <- ggp+geom_line(colour=I(alpha("orange",1/2)))
ggp <- ggp+geom_point(shape=5)
ggp <- ggp+geom_text(colour="darkgreen", size=3, vjust=-1)
ggp


Is there a syntax to change the header text on the legend area
"paste(100 - dframe$percentages,"% of salaries surveyed has more than
"," ?

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: How to customise the text on the legend box
parts:
Sure, just add in:

ggp + scale_colour_hue(name = "% of salaries surveyed more than")

or whatever name you would like it to have.

Cheers,

Josh
